autodetection_retry.title: Detection retry
autodetection_retry.description: How often to retry the initial connection when the job fails to start, in seconds. Zero disables retries.

vnode.title: Virtual Node
vnode.description: Associates this job with a [Virtual Node](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/netdata-agent/configuration/organize-systems-metrics-and-alerts#virtual-nodes). Used only when the node mode is `local`.

url.title: ServiceRoot URL
url.description: URL of the Redfish service. Accepts the origin or the full ServiceRoot path, over HTTP or HTTPS.

node_mode.title: Node mode
node_mode.description: Where the charts appear: `local` publishes them on the collecting node, `system_vnodes` creates one virtual node per ComputerSystem.

system_uri.title: ComputerSystem URI
system_uri.description: Restricts collection to one ComputerSystem, given as its exact resource URI on the same origin. Leave empty to collect every system.

auth_method.title: Authentication method
auth_method.description: How to authenticate with the BMC. `auto` prefers a Redfish session and falls back to HTTP basic authentication.

username.title: Username
username.description: Username of the BMC account. Required unless the authentication method is `none`.

password.title: Password
password.description: Password of the BMC account. Required unless the authentication method is `none`.

retries.title: GET retries
retries.description: Number of extra attempts for a request that fails with a transient error.

max_concurrent_requests.title: Maximum concurrent requests
max_concurrent_requests.description: Maximum number of requests sent to this BMC at the same time. Lower it for controllers that rate-limit.

proxy_url.title: Proxy URL
proxy_url.description: Proxy to use for the BMC requests. Leave empty to use the proxy settings from the environment.

tls_ca.title: TLS CA
tls_ca.description: Path to a CA bundle file used to verify the BMC certificate. Leave empty to use the system trust store.

tls_cert.title: TLS client certificate
tls_cert.description: Path to a client certificate file for mutual TLS. Requires a client key.

tls_key.title: TLS client key
tls_key.description: Path to the client key file for mutual TLS. Requires a client certificate.

tls_skip_verify.title: Skip TLS verification
tls_skip_verify.description: Accept any certificate the BMC presents, including self-signed and expired ones.

collect.title: Collection families
collect.description: Simple pattern selecting which component families to collect: base, compute, memory, thermal, power, storage, network, pcie, sensors, and firmware. Base is always collected.

charts.title: Charts
charts.description: Controls how many charts this job creates.

aggregates.title: Aggregate charts
aggregates.description: Create one summary chart per component family, in addition to any detailed charts.

details.title: Detailed component charts
details.description: Create one chart per individual component, such as each fan, sensor, or drive.

max_detailed_components_per_family.title: Detailed component cap
max_detailed_components_per_family.description: Maximum number of components charted per family and per owner. Zero removes the limit.

alarms.title: Alarms
alarms.description: Controls how the health of a component is decided.

evaluate_thresholds.title: Evaluate source thresholds
evaluate_thresholds.description: Compare readings against the warning and critical thresholds the BMC reports, for components where the BMC reports no health state of its own. A health state reported by the BMC always wins.

host_scope_overrides.title: HostScope overrides
host_scope_overrides.description: Pins the generated virtual nodes to specific GUIDs or hostnames so they stay stable across BMC changes. Used only when the node mode is `system_vnodes`.

resource_uri.title: Resource URI
resource_uri.description: Exact ComputerSystem resource URI this override applies to.

guid.title: GUID
guid.description: GUID to assign to the generated virtual node. Set this or a hostname.

hostname.title: Hostname
hostname.description: Hostname to assign to the generated virtual node. Set this or a GUID.

vnode.ui:help: Charts of this job appear under the Virtual Node instead of this host. Define the Virtual Node in `vnodes.conf` first, then enter its name here.
